_slots_note: THE slot table (IST). Read by the daily pipeline (allocate/approve), the content OS (weekly plan, timing, ledger via cli.cfg_load) and docs. NIGHT was 21:00 here and 20:30 elsewhere until 2026-10-16 (DEC-JR-007). The daily verse Story is not a slot: it posts from daily-bible-post.yml at 06:37 IST.

duration._note: The ONLY duration setting. brief(), the pre-render estimate, render QA and the content OS learning buckets (scripts/content_os/strategy.py) all read it. Set 2026-10-16 (DEC-JR-007): 50-62 s target, 75 s hard ceiling.

buffer.note: ids, not credentials; the API key stays only in secrets.BUFFER_API_KEY

_approval_note: 2026-10-11: human gate removed under Selvin's full-autonomy authorization (config/content-os.json autonomy.full_autonomy). All automated QA gates remain.

daily_verse._note: Daily BSB verse card. 'story' (default since 2026-10-16, DEC-JR-007) keeps it off the Reels grid; set 'post' to go back to a feed post. Buffer GraphQL supports metadata.instagram.type story (https://developers.buffer.com/types/PostType.html). Story cards render at 1080x1920 (BibleVerseStory), feed cards at 1080x1440 (BibleVersePost). YouTube is not used for verse cards.
